COUNT_BALANCED_REFLECTION.theorem: unique integer split: lower iff 2n<L+U; upper iff 2n>L+U
COUNT_BALANCED_REFLECTION.why_unique: No integer is fixed by reflection because L+U is odd; paired interior integers must receive complementary labels, and monotonicity fixes the lower member of every pair as lower.

general_gap.parity: G is odd for every integer m>=1 because x^m has the same parity as x, so consecutive powers have opposite parity.
